name: A10-0107/2026 – Ilhan Kyuchyuk – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, of the other part
part_text:
The European Parliament backs a new partnership agreement between the EU and Uzbekistan, replacing the one from 1999. The agreement covers trade, energy, transport links and political cooperation. Parliament says the deal must be tied to respect for democracy, human rights and the rule of law. It asks both sides to check progress on these points within three years, and it lists concerns about torture, jailed activists, media freedom and treatment of minority groups.

- **What changes:** a new EU-Uzbekistan partnership agreement, with human rights checks after three years.
- **Who it affects:** people in Uzbekistan and EU countries, plus businesses trading between them.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's approval lets the agreement enter into force; Parliament then monitors it.
